prompt: How far does the rear blind spot (No-Zone) extend behind a large commercial freight tractor-trailer?

options.text: Up to 50 feet directly behind the trailer where the driver cannot see you
Up to 500 feet directly behind the trailer where the driver cannot see you
Up to 200 feet directly behind the trailer where the driver cannot see you
Commercial trucks have zero rear blind spots due to wide convex mirrors

svg:
